description: Read actual Gate protection settings before giving an integration production access. Reports observe-only mode, writes without mandatory runs, missing user-token configuration, wildcard grants and approval separation, with evidence, exact remedies and explicit limits. Sends no upstream requests, changes no settings and uses no gateway quota. Configuration-only: not a security certificate or runtime enforcement test.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

app.description: Optional: check one active app id (app_...) instead of all active apps

project_id.description: The project id from gate_create_project, e.g. p1a2b3...

name: gate_check_setup
title: Check an agent integration setup
